title: Assisting Claimants to Seek Recourse from Retailers who Ignore Enforcement Orders of Small Claims Tribunal
what_it_is: Assisting Claimants to Seek Recourse from Retailers who Ignore Enforcement Orders of Small Claims Tribunal

sections.label: Enforcement order application and legal aid
sections.summary: The revised Rules of Court 2021 simplified applying for enforcement orders, and legal advice, legal aid, Community Justice Centre and legal clinics are available.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The process of applying for enforcement orders has been simplified with the introduction of the revised Rules of Court in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: It is now only necessary to file a single application for an enforcement order in the District Court.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Individuals with limited means may apply for legal advice and legal aid from the Legal Aid Bureau (LAB).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Parties who are unclear about the process can also seek advice from the Community Justice Centre, which is located on-site at the State Courts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: There are also legal clinics, like those organised by the Law Society Pro Bono SG and supported by MinLaw, which provide assistance and advice in specific cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: MinLaw is working with stakeholders on further changes to make the enforcement of civil judgments, including SCT orders, as was mentioned by the hon Second Minister for Law at the Committee of Supply debates earlier this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: I am sure many Singaporeans may not be aware that there are so many other avenues that they can look for.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: I had a case in my Meet-the-People Session, which I had sent to MinLaw as well, where the claimant got an order from SCT for the retailer to pay up, but the retailer just refused to pay.

sections.label: Help measures and awareness
sections.summary: The answer states there are a number of help measures and the issue perhaps is awareness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: As mentioned in my answer, there are a number of help measures and the issue perhaps is awareness.
